statement_summary: One program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting the Safeguards Rule and PCI DSS for every division
Group CISO is Qualified Individual; division presidents oversee; PCI DSS charter per CDE
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment per division with roll-up; targeted risk analyses
Risk acceptance authority by level; High cardholder data risks must be treated
Supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; acquired companies adopt group policy within 180 days
Divisions document common control inheritance, including users of other divisions' systems
Service providers, including affiliates, under written safeguards, PCI DSS responsibilities, notice terms, and annual review
Annual common control assessment; division samples; quarterly PCI DSS reviews
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Scope review after significant or organizational change; scope confirmed every six months
Qualified Individual reports in writing to the board at least annually
Unique identities; no identity provider other than SYS-G1 into a CDE after 2027-03-31; weekly reconciliation meanwhile
Role-based least privilege; detokenization and bulk export only for named roles
MFA for all; phishing-resistant for administrators and CDE access; no SMS for CDE access after 2026-12-31; no unapproved exemptions
Service identities owned, governed, and rotated every 90 days
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination, including federated identity providers
Quarterly certification; 90-day inactivity disable
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM
Cross-division access by ticket with purpose and 90-day expiry; no standing access
Vendor access only through PAM; no persistent tunnels
Merchant portal MFA for high-risk roles; merchant administrator MFA; ISV keys shown once
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
Any suspected account data compromise to the bank and network liaison within 1 hour
4-hour covered-services determination for any incident origin; notice under each bank's rule
Notification matrix owned by counsel; contacts confirmed quarterly
Severity 1 to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality
FTC notice for notification events of 500 or more consumers within 30 days of discovery
Annual cross-division exercise with notification, covered-services, and materiality decisions
PAN found where not expected handled as an incident
Encrypt Restricted information; PAN only in a token vault
No PAN by email, chat, or tickets; evidence upload portal with masking
Retention schedule; dispute files purged 90 days after closure; disposal within two years of last use
Tokens only on shared platforms; PAN blocking on every ingestion path; weekly PAN discovery
Immutable cross-site backups with quarterly restore tests
No Restricted or Confidential data in unapproved AI tools
Screen vendors and app developers for covered persons
Annual awareness with phishing; PCI DSS role training for all CDE users including other divisions
Approved generative AI tools only
Never ask for or accept card numbers in email, chat, tickets, or notes
Client environments: per-person credentials in the group secret store
Case export only for supervisors with a ticket; masking on upload; 90-day purge
Contacts for all four sponsor banks confirmed quarterly; 4-hour determination procedure
Key custodians in writing; dual control; annual ceremony audit
Storefront script inventory, integrity checks, and tamper-detection on every theme
Marketplace app review at listing and annually; per-app kill switch
Product and AI change gate (privacy, SOC 2 description, merchant terms)
SYS-M1 reconciled weekly; no MFA exemptions; no SMS for CDE access after 2026-12-31
PCI readiness advisors never work on the group's own scope
